entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I just said. I need to return the band I bought.

Of course. I can certainly look into that for you. I have your account pulled up here. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered about 19 days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not a 'preference'. I was a little busy, so I missed your tiny return window.
I understand. I'm just trying to make sure I process this correctly for you. Was there an event that prevented you from contacting us sooner?
Fine. I had a medical emergency. I was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. Not really focused on fitness trackers.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope you're on the mend. Thank you for letting me know. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've double-checked our policy, and it looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return period. So, there's no issue at all.
Ninety days? Seriously? Then why do all your ads say '10-day satisfaction guarantee'?

That's a great question. Some of our newer electronic products have a different policy, but your VeloBand GPS Tracker falls under our standard 90-day return policy. So, we can absolutely process a full refund for you, no exception needed. I'm generating the prepaid return label now and sending it to the email we have on file.
Right. Would have been nice to know. Saved me the trouble of discussing my surgery with a stranger. Just send the label.

I understand. The label has been sent, you should see it arrive in your inbox shortly. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a speedy recovery.
